/-- A grant counts at `now`: no expiry, or one still ahead. -/
def live (g : model.Grant) (now : I64) : Bool :=
  match g.expires_at with
  | none => true
  | some t => decide (now.val < t.val)

@[step] theorem contains_spec (xs : Slice U64) (x : U64) :
    acl.contains xs x ⦃ v => v = xs.val.any (fun y => decide (y = x)) ⦄ := by
  unfold acl.contains acl.contains_loop
  apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search xs.val (fun y => decide (y = x)) id
    (fun _ _ => true) false _ ?_ 0#usize (by simp))
  · intro v hv; exact search_any _ _ _ hv
  · intro j hj; unfold acl.contains_loop.body; i5h_step

def subjectType : model.Subject → U8
  | .User _ => 0#u8
  | .Group _ => 1#u8
  | .Token _ => 2#u8

def subjectId : model.Subject → U64
  | .User uid | .Group uid | .Token uid => uid

@[step] theorem subject_type_spec (s : model.Subject) :
    acl.subject_type s ⦃ v => v = subjectType s ⦄ := by
  cases s <;> simp [acl.subject_type, subjectType]

@[step] theorem subject_id_spec (s : model.Subject) :
    acl.subject_id s ⦃ v => v = subjectId s ⦄ := by
  cases s <;> simp [acl.subject_id, subjectId]

def subjectMatches (g : model.Grant) (types : Slice U8) (ids : Slice U64) : Bool :=
  types.val.any (fun x => decide (x = subjectType g.subject)) &&
    ids.val.any (fun x => decide (x = subjectId g.subject))

@[step] theorem subject_matches_spec (g : model.Grant) (types : Slice U8) (ids : Slice U64) :
    acl.subject_matches g types ids ⦃ v => v = subjectMatches g types ids ⦄ := by
  unfold acl.subject_matches
  step* <;> simp_all only [subjectMatches] <;>
    simp only [← b_post, Bool.true_and, Bool.false_and]

    acl.groups_for_user_loop.body, acl.add_parents, acl.add_parents_loop,
    acl.add_parents_loop.body, ← hu, ← hm]

theorem find_folder_eq {db db' : model.Db} (hs : SameButGrants db db') (fid : U64) :
    acl.find_folder db' fid = acl.find_folder db fid := by
  simp only [acl.find_folder, acl.find_folder_loop, acl.find_folder_loop.body, ← hs.2.2.2.1]

theorem find_file_eq {db db' : model.Db} (hs : SameButGrants db db') (fid : U64) :
    acl.find_file db' fid = acl.find_file db fid := by
  simp only [acl.find_file, acl.find_file_loop, acl.find_file_loop.body, ← hs.2.2.2.2]

theorem drive_of_eq {db db' : model.Db} (hs : SameButGrants db db') (r : model.Resource) :
    acl.drive_of db' r = acl.drive_of db r := by
  cases r <;> simp only [acl.drive_of, find_folder_eq hs, find_file_eq hs]

theorem drive_policies_eq {db db' : model.Db} (hs : SameButGrants db db') (did : U64) :
    acl.drive_policies db' did = acl.drive_policies db did := by
  simp only [acl.drive_policies, acl.drive_policies_loop, acl.drive_policies_loop.body,
    ← hs.2.2.1]

theorem covers_eq {db db' : model.Db} (hs : SameButGrants db db')
    (g : model.Grant) (target : Slice U64) : covers db' g target = covers db g target := by
  have he : acl.grant_folder_covers db' g target = acl.grant_folder_covers db g target := by
    cases g.resource <;> simp only [acl.grant_folder_covers, find_folder_eq hs]
  have hleft := eq_ok_of_spec (grant_folder_covers_spec db' g target)
  have hright := eq_ok_of_spec (grant_folder_covers_spec db g target)
  rw [he, hright] at hleft
  simpa only [Result.ok.injEq] using hleft.symm

theorem direct_grant_exists_eq {db db' : model.Db} (now : I64)
    (hg : db'.grants.val = db.grants.val.filter (fun g => live g now))
    (types : Slice U8) (ids : Slice U64) (p : model.Permission) (r : model.Resource) :
    acl.direct_grant_exists db' types ids p r now =
      acl.direct_grant_exists db types ids p r now := by
  rw [eq_ok_of_spec (direct_grant_exists_spec db' types ids p r now),
    eq_ok_of_spec (direct_grant_exists_spec db types ids p r now), hg]
  congr 1
  apply any_filter_of_imp
  intro g _ h
  simp only [directPredicate, Bool.and_eq_true] at h
  exact h.2

theorem folder_cascade_loop_eq {db db' : model.Db} (hs : SameButGrants db db') (now : I64)
    (hg : db'.grants.val = db.grants.val.filter (fun g => live g now))
    (types : Slice U8) (ids : Slice U64) (p : model.Permission) (target : alloc.vec.Vec U64) :
    acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists_loop db' types ids p now target 0#usize =
      acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists_loop db types ids p now target 0#usize := by
  rw [eq_ok_of_spec (folder_cascade_loop_spec db' types ids p now target),
    eq_ok_of_spec (folder_cascade_loop_spec db types ids p now target), hg]
  have hp : cascadePredicate db' types ids p now target =
      cascadePredicate db types ids p now target := by
    funext g
    simp only [cascadePredicate, covers_eq hs]
  rw [hp]
  congr 1
  apply any_filter_of_imp
  intro g _ h
  simp only [cascadePredicate, Bool.and_eq_true] at h
  exact h.1.2

theorem folder_cascade_grant_exists_eq {db db' : model.Db} (hs : SameButGrants db db') (now : I64)
    (hg : db'.grants.val = db.grants.val.filter (fun g => live g now))
    (types : Slice U8) (ids : Slice U64) (p : model.Permission) (fid : U64) :
    acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists db' types ids p fid now =
      acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists db types ids p fid now := by
  simp only [acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists, find_folder_eq hs,
    folder_cascade_loop_eq hs now hg]

theorem caller_role_loop_eq {db db' : model.Db} (now : I64)
    (hg : db'.grants.val = db.grants.val.filter (fun g => live g now))
    (did : U64) (types : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (ids : alloc.vec.Vec U64) (best : Option model.Role) :
    acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop db' did now types ids best 0#usize =
      acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop db did now types ids best 0#usize := by
  rw [eq_ok_of_spec (caller_role_loop_spec db' did now types ids best),
    eq_ok_of_spec (caller_role_loop_spec db did now types ids best), hg]
  congr 1
  apply foldl_filter_of_skip
  intro previous g h
  simp [driveStep, h]

theorem caller_role_on_drive_eq {db db' : model.Db} (hs : SameButGrants db db') (now : I64)
    (hg : db'.grants.val = db.grants.val.filter (fun g => live g now))
    (s : model.Subject) (did : U64) :
    acl.caller_role_on_drive db' s did now = acl.caller_role_on_drive db s did now := by
  simp only [acl.caller_role_on_drive, subject_match_set_eq hs, caller_role_loop_eq now hg]

theorem cascade_grant_eq {db db' : model.Db} (hs : SameButGrants db db') (now : I64)
    (hg : db'.grants.val = db.grants.val.filter (fun g => live g now))
    (s : model.Subject) (r : model.Resource) (p : model.Permission) :
    acl.cascade_grant db' s r p now = acl.cascade_grant db s r p now := by
  cases r <;> simp only [acl.cascade_grant, acl.file_parent_folder, find_file_eq hs,
    subject_match_set_eq hs, folder_cascade_grant_exists_eq hs now hg,
    direct_grant_exists_eq now hg]

theorem expired_grants_ignored (db db' : model.Db) (ro : Bool) (now : I64) (s : model.Subject)
    (p : model.Permission) (r : model.Resource) (hs : SameButGrants db db')
    (hg : db'.grants.val = db.grants.val.filter (fun g => live g now)) :
    acl.check db' ro now s p r = acl.check db ro now s p r := by
  simp only [acl.check, drive_of_eq hs, drive_policies_eq hs,
    caller_role_on_drive_eq hs now hg, cascade_grant_eq hs now hg,
    subject_match_set_eq hs, direct_grant_exists_eq now hg]

end oxicloud_kernel.Solution

@[step] theorem contains_spec (ids : Slice U64) (x : U64) :
    acl.contains ids x ⦃ b => b = ids.val.any (fun y => decide (y = x)) ⦄ := by
  unfold acl.contains acl.contains_loop
  apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search ids.val (fun y => decide (y = x)) (fun b : Bool => b)
    (fun _ _ => true) false _ ?_ 0#usize (by simp))
  · intro r hr; rw [search_any _ _ _ hr]
  · intro j hj; unfold acl.contains_loop.body; i5h_step

@[step] theorem contains_u8_spec (ids : Slice U8) (x : U8) :
    acl.contains_u8 ids x ⦃ b => b = ids.val.any (fun y => decide (y = x)) ⦄ := by
  unfold acl.contains_u8 acl.contains_u8_loop
  apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search ids.val (fun y => decide (y = x)) (fun b : Bool => b)
    (fun _ _ => true) false _ ?_ 0#usize (by simp))
  · intro r hr; rw [search_any _ _ _ hr]
  · intro j hj; unfold acl.contains_u8_loop.body; i5h_step

def stype : model.Subject → U8
  | .User _ => 0#u8
  | .Group _ => 1#u8
  | .Token _ => 2#u8

def sid : model.Subject → U64
  | .User x | .Group x | .Token x => x

def smatch (types : List U8) (ids : List U64) (g : model.Grant) : Bool :=
  types.any (fun y => decide (y = stype g.subject)) && ids.any (fun y => decide (y = sid g.subject))

@[step] theorem subject_matches_spec (g : model.Grant) (types : Slice U8) (ids : Slice U64) :
    acl.subject_matches g types ids ⦃ b => b = smatch types.val ids.val g ⦄ := by
  unfold acl.subject_matches smatch
  cases g.subject <;> simp only [acl.subject_type, acl.subject_id, stype, sid] <;> i5h_steps

def roleImp (r : model.Role) : model.Permission → Bool
  | .Read => true
  | .Comment => decide (r = .Commenter ∨ r = .Editor ∨ r = .Owner)
  | .Create => decide (r = .Contributor ∨ r = .Editor ∨ r = .Owner)
  | .Update => decide (r = .Editor ∨ r = .Owner)
  | .Delete | .Share | .Manage => decide (r = .Owner)

@[step] theorem role_implies_spec (r : model.Role) (p : model.Permission) :
    acl.role_implies r p ⦃ b => b = roleImp r p ⦄ := by
  cases r <;> cases p <;> simp [acl.role_implies, model.Role.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqRole.eq,
    model.Role.read_discriminant, roleImp]

@[step] theorem resource_eq_spec (a b : model.Resource) :
    model.Resource.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqResource.eq a b ⦃ c => c = decide (a = b) ⦄ := by
  unfold model.Resource.Insts.CoreCmpPartialEqResource.eq
  cases a <;> cases b <;> simp [model.Resource.read_discriminant, lift]

@[step] theorem live_spec (g : model.Grant) (now : I64) :
    acl.live g now ⦃ b => b = live g now ⦄ := by
  unfold live acl.live
  split <;> simp_all

i5h_derive_clone model.Folder model.Folder.Insts.CoreCloneClone.clone

@[step] theorem find_folder_spec (db : model.Db) (id : U64) :
    acl.find_folder db id ⦃ o => o = db.folders.val.find? (fun f => decide (f.id = id)) ⦄ := by
  unfold acl.find_folder acl.find_folder_loop
  apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search db.folders.val (fun f => decide (f.id = id)) (fun o : Option model.Folder => o)
    (fun _ f => some f) none _ ?_ 0#usize (by simp))
  · intro r hr; rw [search_find _ _ _ hr]
  · intro j hj; unfold acl.find_folder_loop.body; i5h_step

@[step] theorem lpath_contains_spec (a b : Slice U64) : acl.lpath_contains a b ⦃ _ => True ⦄ := by
  unfold acl.lpath_contains; dsimp only
  split
  · simp
  · rename_i h
    unfold acl.lpath_contains_loop
    apply loop.spec_decr_nat (measure := fun (j : Usize) => a.length - j.val)
      (inv := fun j => j.val ≤ a.length)
    · intro j hj
      unfold acl.lpath_contains_loop.body
      i5h_step
    · simp

theorem covers_total (db : model.Db) (t : Slice U64) :
    ∃ c : model.Grant → Bool, ∀ g, acl.grant_folder_covers db g t = ok (c g) := by
  have h : ∀ g, ∃ b, acl.grant_folder_covers db g t = ok b := by
    intro g
    apply ok_of (P := fun _ => True)
    unfold acl.grant_folder_covers
    split <;> i5h_steps
  exact ⟨fun g => Classical.choose (h g), fun g => Classical.choose_spec (h g)⟩

def directP (types : List U8) (ids : List U64) (p : model.Permission) (r : model.Resource)
    (now : I64) (g : model.Grant) : Bool :=
  smatch types ids g && roleImp g.role p && decide (g.resource = r) && live g now

theorem direct_spec (db : model.Db) (types : Slice U8) (ids : Slice U64) (p r now) :
    acl.direct_grant_exists db types ids p r now ⦃ b => b = db.grants.val.any (directP types.val ids.val p r now) ⦄ := by
  unfold acl.direct_grant_exists acl.direct_grant_exists_loop
  apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search db.grants.val (directP types.val ids.val p r now) (fun b : Bool => b)
    (fun _ _ => true) false _ ?_ 0#usize (by simp))
  · intro r hr; rw [search_any _ _ _ hr]
  · intro j hj; unfold acl.direct_grant_exists_loop.body; i5h_step [directP]

def cascadeP (types : List U8) (ids : List U64) (p : model.Permission) (now : I64)
    (c : model.Grant → Bool) (g : model.Grant) : Bool :=
  smatch types ids g && roleImp g.role p && live g now && c g

theorem cascade_loop_spec (db : model.Db) (types : Slice U8) (ids : Slice U64) (p now target)
    (c : model.Grant → Bool) (hc : ∀ g, acl.grant_folder_covers db g (alloc.vec.Vec.deref target) = ok (c g)) :
    acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists_loop db types ids p now target 0#usize
      ⦃ b => b = db.grants.val.any (cascadeP types.val ids.val p now c) ⦄ := by
  unfold acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists_loop
  apply WP.spec_mono (loop_search db.grants.val (cascadeP types.val ids.val p now c) (fun b : Bool => b)
    (fun _ _ => true) false _ ?_ 0#usize (by simp))
  · intro r hr; rw [search_any _ _ _ hr]
  · intro j hj; unfold acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists_loop.body; simp only [hc]; i5h_step [cascadeP]

def rank : model.Role → Nat
  | .Owner => 0
  | .Editor => 1
  | .Contributor => 2
  | .Commenter => 3
  | .Viewer => 4

def strongerM (a : Option model.Role) (b : model.Role) : Option model.Role :=
  match a with
  | none => some b
  | some x => if rank b < rank x then some b else some x

@[step] theorem stronger_spec (a : Option model.Role) (b : model.Role) :
    acl.stronger a b ⦃ o => o = strongerM a b ⦄ := by
  cases a with
  | none => simp [acl.stronger, strongerM]
  | some x => cases b <;> cases x <;> simp [acl.stronger, strongerM, acl.role_rank, rank]

def roleStep (types : List U8) (ids : List U64) (d : U64) (now : I64)
    (best : Option model.Role) (g : model.Grant) : Option model.Role :=
  if smatch types ids g && decide (g.resource = .Drive d) && live g now then strongerM best g.role else best

theorem role_loop_spec (db : model.Db) (d now) (types : alloc.vec.Vec U8) (ids : alloc.vec.Vec U64) :
    acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop db d now types ids none 0#usize
      ⦃ o => o = db.grants.val.foldl (roleStep types.val ids.val d now) none ⦄ := by
  unfold acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop
  apply WP.spec_mono (loop_fold db.grants.val (fun o : Option model.Role => o) (roleStep types.val ids.val d now)
    (fun _ _ => True) _ ?_ none 0#usize (by simp) trivial)
  · intro r hr; rw [hr]; simp
  · intro s j hj _; unfold acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop.body; i5h_step [roleStep, alloc.vec.Vec.deref]

theorem any_filter_of {α} (l : List α) (p q : α → Bool) (h : ∀ a, q a = true → p a = true) :
    (l.filter p).any q = l.any q := by
  induction l with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a t ih =>
    by_cases hp : p a
    · simp [hp, ih]
    · have : q a = false := by
        cases hq : q a
        · rfl
        · exact absurd (h a hq) hp
      simp [hp, ih, this]

theorem foldl_filter_of {α β} (l : List α) (p : α → Bool) (f : β → α → β) (init : β)
    (h : ∀ b a, p a = false → f b a = b) :
    (l.filter p).foldl f init = l.foldl f init := by
  induction l generalizing init with
  | nil => rfl
  | cons a t ih =>
    by_cases hp : p a
    · simp [hp, ih]
    · simp only [List.filter_cons, hp, Bool.false_eq_true, ↓reduceIte, List.foldl_cons]
      rw [h init a (by simpa using hp), ih]

theorem smset_indep (db : model.Db) (gs) (s : model.Subject) :
    acl.subject_match_set { db with grants := gs } s = acl.subject_match_set db s := rfl
theorem drive_of_indep (db : model.Db) (gs) (r) :
    acl.drive_of { db with grants := gs } r = acl.drive_of db r := rfl
theorem drive_policies_indep (db : model.Db) (gs) (d) :
    acl.drive_policies { db with grants := gs } d = acl.drive_policies db d := rfl
theorem find_folder_indep (db : model.Db) (gs) (d) :
    acl.find_folder { db with grants := gs } d = acl.find_folder db d := rfl
theorem file_parent_folder_indep (db : model.Db) (gs) (d) :
    acl.file_parent_folder { db with grants := gs } d = acl.file_parent_folder db d := rfl
theorem covers_indep (db : model.Db) (gs) (g t) :
    acl.grant_folder_covers { db with grants := gs } g t = acl.grant_folder_covers db g t := rfl

section
variable (db : model.Db) (gs : alloc.vec.Vec model.Grant) (now : I64)
  (hg : gs.val = db.grants.val.filter (fun g => live g now))
include hg

theorem direct_eq (types : Slice U8) (ids : Slice U64) (p r) :
    acl.direct_grant_exists { db with grants := gs } types ids p r now =
      acl.direct_grant_exists db types ids p r now := by
  rw [eq_ok_of_spec (direct_spec { db with grants := gs } types ids p r now),
    eq_ok_of_spec (direct_spec db types ids p r now)]
  simp only [hg]
  rw [any_filter_of]
  intro a ha; simp [directP] at ha; exact ha.2.2.2

theorem cascade_exists_eq (types : Slice U8) (ids : Slice U64) (p fid) :
    acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists { db with grants := gs } types ids p fid now =
      acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists db types ids p fid now := by
  unfold acl.folder_cascade_grant_exists
  rw [find_folder_indep]
  congr 1; funext o
  cases o with
  | none => rfl
  | some f =>
    obtain ⟨c, hc⟩ := covers_total db (alloc.vec.Vec.deref f.lpath)
    simp only
    rw [eq_ok_of_spec (cascade_loop_spec { db with grants := gs } types ids p now f.lpath c
        (fun g => by rw [covers_indep]; exact hc g)),
      eq_ok_of_spec (cascade_loop_spec db types ids p now f.lpath c hc)]
    simp only [hg]
    rw [any_filter_of]
    intro a ha; simp [cascadeP] at ha; exact ha.2.2.1

theorem caller_eq (s d) :
    acl.caller_role_on_drive { db with grants := gs } s d now = acl.caller_role_on_drive db s d now := by
  unfold acl.caller_role_on_drive
  rw [smset_indep]
  congr 1; funext x
  obtain ⟨types, ids⟩ := x
  show acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop _ d now types ids none 0#usize = acl.caller_role_on_drive_loop db d now types ids none 0#usize
  rw [eq_ok_of_spec (role_loop_spec { db with grants := gs } d now types ids),
    eq_ok_of_spec (role_loop_spec db d now types ids)]
  simp only [hg]
  rw [foldl_filter_of]
  intro b a ha; simp [roleStep, ha]

theorem cascade_grant_eq (s r p) :
    acl.cascade_grant { db with grants := gs } s r p now = acl.cascade_grant db s r p now := by
  unfold acl.cascade_grant
  simp only [smset_indep, file_parent_folder_indep, cascade_exists_eq db gs now hg,
    direct_eq db gs now hg]

end

theorem expired_grants_ignored (db db' : model.Db) (ro : Bool) (now : I64) (s : model.Subject)
    (p : model.Permission) (r : model.Resource) (hs : SameButGrants db db')
    (hg : db'.grants.val = db.grants.val.filter (fun g => live g now)) :
    acl.check db' ro now s p r = acl.check db ro now s p r := by
  have e : db' = { db with grants := db'.grants } := by
    obtain ⟨h1, h2, h3, h4, h5⟩ := hs
    cases db; cases db'; simp_all
  clear hs
  generalize db'.grants = gs at e hg
  subst e
  unfold acl.check
  simp only [drive_of_indep, drive_policies_indep, smset_indep, caller_eq db gs now hg,
    cascade_grant_eq db gs now hg, direct_eq db gs now hg]

end oxicloud_kernel.Solution
